title: Length of the tableau gate list
statement: For every finite-state Turing machine $M$ with Boolean input alphabet and every $n,t\in\mathbb{N}$, the gate list at time $t$ in the tableau construction has length $2+tW$, where $W$ is the total width of the tableau gadgets for $M$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state Turing machine over Boolean symbols
